title: Mean versus uncertainty-aware ranking under random reporting
purpose: Primary test: does SHRINK(5) recover true quality order better than MEAN; how the gap varies with review count and noise
primary_outcome: Dbar: equal-weight mean over 9 cells of paired Kendall tau-b difference SHRINK(5) minus MEAN
status: frozen (owner-approved 2026-11-24); confirmatory matrix complete 2026-11-25 (M3): 180 of 180 runs ok, 0 failed; JRN-0007; H1 supported under the frozen rule, direction depends on sigma (A-2); standalone report pending, generated tables in research/experiments/EXP-001/results_tables.md
planned_analysis: Paired per-seed differences; per-cell 95% percentile bootstrap (10000) with t cross-check; pooled stratified bootstrap one-sided 95% lower bound; Holm for secondary contrasts

title: Reporting selection and quality-dependent missingness
purpose: Secondary: does the advantage of SHRINK(5) and LCB over MEAN change with under-reporting selection (lambda) and exposure-quality coupling (gamma)
primary_outcome: Paired difference E[D | lambda=2] minus E[D | lambda=0] averaged over gamma and nu strata (nondirectional)
status: frozen (owner-approved 2026-11-24); confirmatory matrix complete 2026-11-25 (M3): 240 of 240 runs ok, 0 failed; JRN-0008; standalone report pending, generated tables in research/experiments/EXP-002/results_tables.md
planned_analysis: Same-seed paired bootstrap within strata; Holm across lambda and gamma contrasts

title: Sensitivity analyses that could invalidate the main interpretation
purpose: Check whether the EXP-001 conclusion survives zero-review convention, prior misspecification, truth definition and quality distribution changes
primary_outcome: Pooled Dbar per sensitivity condition compared with EXP-001 Dbar (sign and interval)
status: frozen (owner-approved 2026-11-24); confirmatory matrix complete 2026-11-25 (M3): S1 to S4, 1140 of 1140 runs ok, 0 failed; JRN-0009; S2 and S4 invalidation criteria met; S3 non-diagnostic for rank metrics (D-012); standalone report pending, generated tables in research/experiments/EXP-003/results_tables.md
planned_analysis: Two-sided 95% stratified bootstrap per condition; prespecified invalidation criteria S1-S4
